narr: An unstable air mass was present across central North Carolina in the afternoon and evening of July 1. An approaching cold front, along with a large upper-level trough, were present across Virginia and North Carolina. Scattered thunderstorms developed over central South Carolina and moved northeast into North Carolina. These storms merged into a line of storms that produced widespread strong winds that downed numerous trees in central North Carolina.
ev: Hawthorne and Miller streets were flooded Winston-Salem due to heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
lsr: HAWTHORNE AND MILLER STREETS FLOODED IN WINSTON SALEM.
